name: India–Pakistan
summary: Tense border but no cross-border military strikes since 2025
state: Indian border guards shot dead two people on the Punjab border on 2 Oct, and both countries summoned diplomats (Al Jazeera, 3 Oct). No cross-border military strikes have occurred since the 2025 clashes, and no new Line of Control incident had been reported as of 1 Nov.
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice before travelling near the India–Pakistan border.

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Pakistan, India summon diplomats after two people killed in border incident

why: Two nuclear-armed neighbours with a history of rapid escalation after terrorist attacks.
drivers: Kashmir attacks, Line of Control firing, water disputes (Indus), domestic politics.

rubric.watch: Ceasefire violations, a major terrorist attack with blame assigned, or treaty suspensions.
rubric.normal: Ceasefire holding along the Line of Control; no major attacks.
